CustomField.description: Payment block of the monthly receipt: CreditCardLines = CustomFields, one credit card line per charge (default, D33: every donation is a card charge); Cash = top-level Cash; DealNumbers = DealNumbers[]. Blank = CreditCardLines, or DealNumbers when Receipt_Link_Deal_Numbers__c is on. Verify CreditCardLines on terminal 1001 and with Cardcom for production (Q15) before the first receipt run.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: CreditCardLines = שורת אשראי לכל חיוב (ברירת מחדל); Cash = מזומן; DealNumbers = קישור מספרי עסקאות. ריק = אשראי.
CustomField.label: Receipt Payment Mode
